categories.main_business_segments: Huarui Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of small and micro motor commutators, which are core components of motors. Its main application markets include automotive motors (both fuel and new energy vehicles), electric tools (including garden tools), household appliances, and expanding into medical devices and other high-end industrial fields. The company also produces various types of commutators such as full-plastic, slot-type, hook-type, coil-type, and flat-type, covering over 2,000 specifications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes industry-leading full-plastic one-time molding production technology and fully automated production lines. It emphasizes continuous innovation in production processes, including automated sorting, pressing, visual inspection, and precision machining. The firm holds 124 valid patents, including 41 invention patents, and focuses on R&D in hollow cup motor commutators and other advanced motor components, aiming to improve product reliability and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include globally recognized automotive and motor manufacturers such as BorgWarner, NIDEC, Yanfeng Adient, Bosch Group, Makita, and Black & Decker. The primary markets served are automotive motors (including new energy vehicles), electric tools, household appliances, and emerging sectors like smart home devices and medical equipment. The company has deepened cooperation with major clients in the new energy vehicle sector and expanded its presence in domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in East China, South China, and overseas markets. East China accounts for the largest revenue share, followed by South China and overseas regions. It has production bases in Ningbo (Yinzhou and Beilun districts) and Huai'an, Jiangsu Province, supporting its scale manufacturing capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huarui operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of key motor components, specifically commutators. It procures raw materials such as copper and phenolic powder and supplies finished commutators to motor assemblers and OEMs in automotive, electric tools, and household appliance industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D to maintain competitive advantage, focusing on developing high-performance commutators for automotive applications, including new energy vehicles, and expanding into hollow cup motor commutators for medical and aerospace fields. It invests in automation and digital transformation (ERP, MES, WMS systems) to enhance production efficiency and product traceability. Key R&D projects include commutators for automotive gull-wing doors, lumbar adjustment motors, rail compressor auxiliary systems, portable washer-dryer motors, low-noise air purifier motors, smart door lock motors, and high-power stone cutting machine commutators.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of commutator products to automotive manufacturers, electric tool producers, and household appliance companies. The company employs direct sales and consignment warehouse sales models, with a comprehensive after-sales service system. Revenue also includes income from sales of copper scrap and rental income from fixed assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huarui is a leading enterprise and a market leader in the commutator industry in China, recognized for its strong brand, extensive product range, and high-quality standards. It competes with other domestic and international motor component manufacturers, maintaining competitive advantages through technological innovation, scale production, and strong customer relationships with global automotive and motor companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 751.9 million, a 12.94% increase year-over-year, with main business revenue of RMB 576 million, up 14.78%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 3.27 million, significantly improved from the previous year's loss. Total assets stood at RMB 973 million, with net assets of RMB 515 million. The company’s R&D investment was RMB 32.17 million, accounting for 4.28% of revenue. Despite profitability challenges, the company shows steady revenue growth and ongoing operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huarui emphasizes high product performance, reliability, and timely delivery, critical for motor efficiency and quality. Its full-plastic one-time molding technology and automated production lines enable high-quality, diverse product offerings covering a wide range of specifications. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading automotive and motor manufacturers differentiate it in the market. It also focuses on digital transformation and customer service excellence to enhance value and competitiveness.
